Method of Attack: Differential Fault Attack (DFA) exploiting energy management systems like Dynamic Voltage and Frequency Scaling (DVFS) to induce single byte errors by overclocking CPU and stressing hardware remotely
Remote attack via malicious code interacting with device drivers to alter voltage and frequency regulators causing stress conditions necessary for DFA
Discoverer: Team of three scientists from Columbia University
Impacted Systems: ARM TrustZone component on mobile CPUs (Android devices)
Modern chipsets with energy management systems
Attack Vector: Remote code execution via malicious content from the Internet that manipulates energy management system settings
